# Boomin Developers

Boomin docs: https://developers.boomin.ai

Core surfaces:
- Browser SDK: `@boomin/connect`; CLI: `@boomin/cli`
- Install: `npm install @boomin/connect @boomin/server`
- Initialize app config: `npx @boomin/cli init`
- Signed handoff scaffold: `npx @boomin/cli handoff init --framework next --auth custom`
- Referral-first scaffold: `npx @boomin/cli referral init --framework next --auth custom --write`
- Agent skill install: `npx @boomin/cli@latest skill install`
- MCP hosted install: `npx @boomin/cli@latest mcp install`
- MCP manual hosted install: `claude mcp add --transport http boomin https://mcp.boomin.ai/mcp`
- MCP local stdio install: `npx @boomin/mcp` or `npx @boomin/cli mcp`
- Creator Connect API: https://api.boomin.ai/v1/connect
- Platform API: https://api.boomin.ai/v1/platform
- Connect OpenAPI: https://developers.boomin.ai/openapi/connect.yaml
- Platform OpenAPI: https://developers.boomin.ai/openapi/platform.yaml

Use public `pk_live_...` keys in browser code for Creator Connect.
Never expose private `sk_boomin_live_...` platform tokens in browser code.

Recommended Creator Connect flow:
1. `Boomin.init({ publicKey, programId, apiBase, redirectUri })`
2. `Boomin.requestOtp({ email, name })`
3. `Boomin.verifyOtp({ email, code })`
4. `Boomin.connectInstagram({ requireCreator: true })`
5. `Boomin.getConnectStatus(sessionId)`

Recommended signed handoff flow for apps with existing users:
1. Install `@boomin/server` on the server.
2. Run `npx @boomin/cli referral init --framework next --auth clerk --write`.
3. Return `{ externalUserId, email, name, metadata }` from your auth provider.
4. Sign with `BOOMIN_HANDOFF_SIGNING_SECRET`.
5. Show the generated `/partner` page with referral link, metrics, and optional Instagram connect.

Referral-first first value:
1. User visits `/partner`.
2. User clicks join.
3. Server sends signed handoff to Boomin.
4. Boomin returns `referral: { code, url, active }` and `metrics`.
5. `/r/[code]` records `link_clicks` and redirects to the app destination with `?ref=<code>`.

CLI commands:
- `npx @boomin/cli --help`
- `npx @boomin/cli login`
- `npx @boomin/cli init`
- `npx @boomin/cli status --json`
- `npx @boomin/cli scopes --json`
- `npx @boomin/cli scopes explain units:create`
- `npx @boomin/cli token create --name "Agent" --scopes org:read,units:read,units:create`
- `npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --read-only --token sk_boomin_live_...`
- `npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --write --cleanup --token sk_boomin_live_...`
- `npx @boomin/cli platform smoke --all-scopes --cleanup --json`
- `npx @boomin/cli handoff init --framework next --auth clerk`
- `npx @boomin/cli referral init --framework next --auth clerk --write`
- `npx @boomin/cli skill install`
- `npx @boomin/cli mcp install`
- `npx @boomin/cli doctor --json`

MCP skill packs:
- `Referral Program Installer` is default and can diagnose, scaffold, verify, read standing, and record test events.
- `Program Operator` is admin-only and can update channels, requirements, tiers, referral settings, and evaluate programs.

Key docs:

- Browser SDK: https://developers.boomin.ai/creator-connect/browser-sdk/
